description: Asks to remove one of the workspace's AI app sign-ins: everyone signed in through it is signed out and the app's connector stops working. It can't be undone. Owners and admins only. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended.

client_id.description: The sign-in's Client ID (list_sign_in_clients gives them).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: remove_sign_in_client
title: Remove an AI app sign-in
